decision: Test equal .5/.5 tab/rest-clothing loss on the same single calibration seed first. Keep original source, mask, LR, frozen layers and preservation weights unchanged to isolate region weighting. Expand identities only after demonstrating a convincing tab and retained facial quality.
limitations: Manual trace intersected with existing approved clothing mask; original jaw remains protected.
Pixel-loss imbalance supports an experiment, not a guarantee that the missing tab is caused only by weighting.
Single training seed and two fixed unseen previews cannot prove generalization.
